question: The fisher tells me the channel runs silver and that the creatures rise when it does. He offers this as a fact about the world and not as a puzzle. I cannot decide whether the silver brings them or whether both follow from something I have not seen.
local_knowledge: Thal-uvai: the water remembers. Said of the basin on still nights after rain, and of two or three other things.
academic_hypothesis: Lunar tidal influence on a closed basin, per the Narmada literature on coastal anomalies.

resolutions.conclusion: The moon draws the water and the water draws the creatures, as the University would have it.
resolutions.revisit: It happens under heavy cloud and at every phase. Whatever the moon is doing, it is not this.

resolutions.conclusion: A bloom rises in the closed basin when rain freshens its surface; the small fish follow the bloom and everything else follows the small fish. The Kia phrase says the same thing in four words and does not pretend to a mechanism.

notes: The opening question. The academic reading is available first and is wrong, which is the point: the player should be able to close the entry early and be mistaken.
